csv_project_name: Design for Brown Bridge Quiet Area Expansion Spring Lake
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Traverse City is requesting proposals from qualified firms for professional engineering and design services, plus construction management oversight for the construction of a trail and trailhead amenities at the Brown Bridge Quiet Area located in East Bay Township (GPS coordinates for driveway are approximately: 44.663554, -85.492820). Services are to include but not be limited to: geotechnical investigations and reports as needed, topographic and tree surveying, wetland delineation, removal and clearing plans, site improvement plans, maintenance of traffic plans, preparation of specifications, construction cost estimate, permitting services, bidding services, construction staking and construction engineering and management, permit compliance.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Inspection Services, Planning/Master Planning, Biological Studies/Natural Resources, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design
